content:
name: 'ci: onboarding'
run-name: 'ci: onboarding'

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/onboarding.yml
      - scripts/test/onboarding/**
      - scripts/setup.mjs
      - scripts/setup/**
      - scripts/develop/**
      - scripts/lib/tools/**
      - scripts/lib/paths.mts
      - scripts/lib/named-blocks.mts
      - scripts/lib/external-tools.mjs
      - scripts/lib/npm.mjs
      - scripts/lib/package-manager.mjs
      - scripts/package-manager.mjs
      - .config/external-tools.json
      - .npmrc
      - package.json
      - package-lock.json
      - README.md
  pull_request:
    branches: [master, improve/v2-developer-workflow]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/onboarding.yml
      - scripts/test/onboarding/**
      - scripts/setup.mjs
      - scripts/setup/**
      - scripts/develop/**
      - scripts/lib/tools/**
      - scripts/lib/paths.mts
      - scripts/lib/named-blocks.mts
      - scripts/lib/external-tools.mjs
      - scripts/lib/npm.mjs
      - scripts/lib/package-manager.mjs
      - scripts/package-manager.mjs
      - .config/external-tools.json
      - .npmrc
      - package.json
      - package-lock.json
      - README.md
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: v2-onboarding-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  plan:
    name: onboarding changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-26.04
    outputs:
      run: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:
          node-version: '22.18.0'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Compare onboarding inputs
        id: plan
        env:
          ONBOARDING_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
        run: node scripts/test/onboarding/plan.mts

  journey:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.run == 'true'
    name: '${{ matrix.scenario }} (${{ matrix.os }}, npm)'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 50
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: ${{ fromJSON(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '["ubuntu-26.04"]' || '["ubuntu-26.04","macos-15","windows-2025"]') }}
        scenario: [bootstrap, journey]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.scenario == 'bootstrap' && '22.18.0' || '26.11.0' }}
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Follow the README and guided contributor tasks
        env:
          ONBOARDING_SCENARIO: ${{ matrix.scenario }}
        run: node scripts/test/onboarding/run.mts "${{ matrix.scenario }}"
      - name: Upload onboarding diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: onboarding-v2-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ matrix.scenario }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: .cache/onboarding/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
